BiblicalUsage: gᵉbereth — lady, queen. That is the whole of it, and it is enough: 9 occurrences, and in Genesis, 2 Kings, Psalms, and Proverbs the meaning never wavers. I keep coming back to the simple reading because the simple reading is the true one.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe gᵉbereth matters because God speaks plainly, and plain words carry real weight. I hold that the simple reading is the true one, and I will not trade it for a clever one.
RelatedEvents: Hagar and Ishmael; Naaman Healed of Leprosy
